propositions: Validation logic is sometimes implemented in CLI commands while MCP/library/reconciler paths skip it, creating inconsistent enforcement across interfaces.
The engine-vs-interface placement decision for validation is made silently at plan time and never subject to review.

A new ADVISORY plan-review criterion project.engine-layer-enforcement should deterministically trigger when plan scope touches src/rebar/_commands/ or interface modules with validation/guard/check work.
The criterion must be registered in the criteria routing overlay and documented in the generated plan-review-criteria-guide to enable rebar explain lookups.
Advisory (non-blocking) posture allows legitimate interface-local placement while teaching engineers the distinction between CLI and engine enforcement seams.
